## Turkish Daily Word v1.0.0

First stable release of the browser-based daily Turkish word game.

### Highlights

- deterministic daily five-letter puzzle anchored to `Europe/Istanbul`
- Turkish-aware Unicode normalization, including dotted and dotless I handling
- duplicate-letter-safe scoring
- six-guess board with physical and on-screen Turkish keyboards
- local progress, statistics, streaks, theme preference, and shareable result grid
- local-first guess validation with a public Turkish dictionary fallback for missing words
- fabricated letter combinations are rejected and dictionary outages never consume an attempt
- responsive light/dark UI and GitHub Pages deployment
- automated Node.js tests and CI
